title: Delegation
description: What a delegation's run has come to, as the daemon reads it when a client asks for the view DelegationResult: one row per run that a Delegate created. The route, the path and the protocol are the run's event `runbook.delegated`; the state, the outcome and the failure are the Run's; the calls, the tokens and the cost are the sum of the run's events `runbook.model-call` (one per call the relay booked); the result text is the file result.md of the run's work/ directory, read through the reader of ProductOfRun (no link followed, at most `result_limit` bytes), and the products are the paths ProductsOfRun lists. The language cannot read a file system, so no command creates or changes a row, as with RunProducts.

run_state.description: Where the run stands. Not `state`: that member of an entity is its lifecycle, and no command moves a row of this one.

outcome.description: The run's outcome once it Ended.

failure.description: Why the run failed to start, or what failed it after it started (the runtime's reason); absent otherwise.

route.description: The model route of the run, by name.

protocol.description: The runbook the run runs: the named one, or delegation-free.

confidence.description: The classifier's confidence, a number from 0 to 1, for a classified delegation; null for the paths named and free.

result_text.description: The text of result.md in the run's work/ directory, at most `result_limit` bytes; absent while the run has written none, and for a file that is not text.

result_truncated.description: True when result.md holds more than `result_limit` bytes: `result_text` is its start.

result_limit.description: The most bytes of result.md the view answers: 1048576.

products.description: The paths of the files of the run's work/ directory, as ProductsOfRun lists them.

calls.description: The model calls the relay booked for the run.

input_tokens.description: The input tokens those calls reported; a call that reported none adds 0.

cost_micro_usd.description: What the calls booked: the route's declared price times the tokens, else the reservation of a call of unknown cost.

cost_known.description: False when any call was booked at its reservation because its cost was not known.

sdc.daemon.DelegationId.title: DelegationId
sdc.daemon.DelegationId.description: A delegation as a row of Delegation: its text is the run's id. A type of its own, not RunId, because a row is what the daemon reads of the run's record and files, not the run.

sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.title: DelegationPath
sdc.daemon.DelegationPath.description: How a delegation became a run (docs/model-routes.md, section 9): named (it named a protocol, and that runbook runs with the request as its intake) or free (it named none: the free run, one agent node whose instruction is the request, writing result.md). The paths classified and generated come with classify and build and are not in the set until the daemon takes them.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.

sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome
sdc.daemon.RunOutcome.description: Open text: the outcome name of the runbook's protocol for the root case, or one of the daemon's own causes (`orphaned`, `runtime-failure`). The run's state is the closed set; the outcome is not.

sdc.daemon.RunbookId.title: RunbookId
sdc.daemon.RunbookId.description: The name of a runbook: a preset (sdc, sdc-bugfix) or the name of a runbook in the daemon's --runbook-dir.
